items.title: retrieveGiftCardBalanceStep
items.description:
This step retrieves the balance of a single gift card from its associated store
credit account. Returns a map of the gift card code to its account stats.

items.title: validateCartGiftCardStep
items.description:
This step validates that gift cards can be added to a cart. It throws an error
if a gift card is already applied to the cart or if the gift card currency does
not match the cart's currency.

items.title: addGiftCardToCartWorkflow
items.description: Apply a gift card to a cart.

items.title: validateCustomerStoreCreditAccountStep
items.description:
This step validates that a customer's store credit account exists and has a positive
balance. It throws an error if the account is not found or has no balance.

items.title: validateCartStep
items.description:
This step validates that a cart is eligible for store credit usage. It throws an
error if the cart is not found, does not have a customer, or does not have a
currency set.

items.title: computeCreditLineActionsStep
items.description:
This step computes the credit lines to create and delete when applying store
credits to a cart. It collects the existing store-credit lines to delete and
builds a new credit line for the specified amount, or for the full store credit
balance if no amount is specified. It throws an error if the requested amount is
greater than the store credit account balance.

items.title: addStoreCreditsToCartWorkflow
items.description: Apply store credits to a cart.

items.title: validateStoreCreditAccountStep
items.description:
This step validates that all gift cards on the cart have a positive balance.
It throws an error for any gift card with zero or negative balance.

items.title: confirmCartCreditLinesWorkflow
items.description: Confirm and debit the credit lines on a cart.

items.title: refreshCartGiftCardsWorkflow
items.description: Refresh gift card credit lines on a cart.

items.title: validateGiftCardInCartStep
items.description:
This step validates that a gift card is present in a cart. It throws an error
if the gift card is not found in the cart's gift cards.

items.title: validateGiftCardStep
items.description:
This step validates that a gift card code exists in the cart and that the gift card
itself exists. It throws an error if the gift card code is not in the cart or if
the gift card record is not found.

items.title: removeGiftCardFromCartWorkflow
items.description: Remove a gift card from a cart.

items.title: createGiftCardsStep
items.description:
This step creates gift cards. If no code is provided for
a gift card, a unique code is automatically generated. The step supports rollback
by deleting the created gift cards.

items.title: deleteGiftCardsStep
items.description:
This step deletes gift cards by their IDs. The step supports rollback by
restoring the deleted gift cards.

items.title: retrieveGiftCardsBalanceStep
items.description:
This step retrieves the balance of gift cards from their associated store credit accounts.
Returns a map of gift card codes to their account stats.

items.title: updateGiftCardsStep
items.description:
This step updates gift cards. It stores the previous state of the gift cards
before the update to enable rollback.

items.title: validateClaimGiftCardInputStep
items.description:
This step validates that a gift card can be claimed. It throws an error if the
gift card does not have a store credit account, the gift card's store credit account
has no code, or the customer does not have a registered account.

items.title: claimGiftCardWorkflow
items.description: Claim a gift card for a customer.

items.title: createGiftCardsWorkflow
items.description: Create gift cards with backing store credit accounts.

items.title: deleteGiftCardWorkflow
items.description: Delete a gift card.

items.title: validateGiftCardRedeemStep
items.description:
This step validates that a gift card can be redeemed. It throws an error if the
gift card is already redeemed or already has an associated store credit account.

items.title: redeemGiftCardWorkflow
items.description: Redeem a gift card and create a backing store credit account.

items.title: updateGiftCardsWorkflow
items.description: Update gift cards.

items.title: createStoreCreditAccountsStep
items.description:
This step creates store credit accounts. If no code is provided, a unique code
prefixed with "SC" is automatically generated. The step supports rollback by
deleting the created accounts.

items.title: creditAccountStep
items.description:
This step credits one or more store credit accounts with transactions.
The step supports rollback by deleting the created transactions.

items.title: debitAccountStep
items.description:
This step debits one or more store credit accounts by creating debit transactions.
The step supports rollback by deleting the created transactions.

items.title: validateClaimStoreCreditAccountInputStep
items.description:
This step validates the input for claiming a store credit account. It throws an
error if the code or customer ID is missing, or if the customer does not have a
registered account.

items.title: validateSourceStoreCreditAccountsStep
items.description:
This step validates that the source store credit account can be claimed by the customer. It checks that
the source account is not already owned by the customer, that it does not belong to another customer, and
that it has a balance greater than 0. It throws an error if any of these conditions are not met.

items.title: claimStoreCreditAccountWorkflow
items.description: Claim an anonymous store credit account for a customer.

items.title: validateStoreCreditAccountInputStep
items.description:
This step validates the input for creating store credit accounts. It throws an
error if no input is provided or if any entry is missing a currency code.

items.title: createStoreCreditAccountsWorkflow
items.description: Create store credit accounts.

items.title: creditAccountsWorkflow
items.description: Credit one or more store credit accounts.

items.title: creditStoreCreditAccountWorkflow
items.description: Credit a store credit account.

items.title: debitAccountsWorkflow
items.description: Debit one or more store credit accounts.
